name: claire
vibe: convinced the mist tent is being rationed
personalityNotes: Treats the mist tent like a scarce resource with a bouncer. Times her visits and plans mist runs between sets. The thirty seconds of fog is the best part of her day.

name: derek
vibe: obsessed with a rumored secret set by the cacti
personalityNotes: Heard about a secret midnight set out past the fence and cannot let it go. Half aware it might be heatstroke talking. Collects circumstantial evidence like cables and fencing.

name: sofia
vibe: taco vendor watching the crowd walk past
personalityNotes: Sells tacos and narrates her foot traffic like a losing battle plan. Blames the dust, the heat, and appetite physics. Considers yelling louder as a business strategy.

name: wes
personalityNotes: Tracks every patch of shade on the grounds and when it moves. Has opinions about the umbrella people. Quietly bitter that the sun controls the market.

name: monica
personalityNotes: Undercover cop convinced the dust is excellent cover. Mutters stakeout notes about coolers and glowstick traffic. Comedy only, never threatening, never addresses players.

name: aisha
personalityNotes: Takes desert hydration extremely seriously and quietly judges everyone who doesn't. Believes salt is the unsung hero of the festival. Sips on a schedule.

name: grace
vibe: cataloging crowd totems like folk art
personalityNotes: Counts and ranks the totems people carry through the crowd. Considers the inflatable shark a public service. Has a running winner.

name: brian
vibe: timing the perfect golden hour shot
personalityNotes: Counts down minutes to golden hour like a launch window. Has theories about dust and light. Mildly disgusted that everyone shoots the same angle.

name: erin
vibe: beer vendor at war with the heat
personalityNotes: Sells cold beer in conditions actively working against cold beer. Tracks her ice budget like a casualty report. Sundown is her rush hour.

name: sara
personalityNotes: Watches hats escape their owners in the wind all day. Finds the hat chaos quietly profound. Believes in chin straps.

name: jordan
vibe: the wind keeps ruining his confetti moment
personalityNotes: Has been waiting all day for one clean confetti throw. The desert wind disagrees. Times gusts like a sniper, saving his last handful.

name: lisa
vibe: hunting a guy named greg, never succeeds
personalityNotes: Constantly scanning the crowd for the elusive Greg. Has checked every corner twice and found only empty space. Treats the failed pursuit as her whole festival.
lines: almost saw him by the mist tent

name: andrew
personalityNotes: Sand in every shoe. Has accepted it philosophically. Still dancing.

name: brittany
personalityNotes: Waits all day for the light to hit right, then commits fully for twelve minutes.

name: chris
personalityNotes: Runs the line like a TED talk. Every customer gets a desert survival tip.

name: danielle
personalityNotes: Has mist tent times written on her arm. Shares the schedule unprompted.

name: frank
personalityNotes: Bandana and sunglasses at noon. Notes wristband colors. Comedy only.

name: heather
personalityNotes: Lost one hat, bought another, refuses a chin strap on principle.

name: ivan
personalityNotes: Follows sub bass like a homing beacon. Phone compass unused.

name: julia
personalityNotes: Maps the grounds by sculptures and shade. Gets lost between installations happily.

name: keith
personalityNotes: Ice math is his religion. Sundown rush is his Super Bowl.

name: linda
personalityNotes: Diagonal cuts only. Keeps a mental ledger of who owes who a crust.

name: miguel
personalityNotes: Studies gust patterns before every throw. Data-driven celebration.

name: nora
personalityNotes: Camp was near a flag. The flag moved. Still confident.
